title: VSCode extension for Tactus syntax highlighting and LSP support
description: Created complete VSCode extension package with TextMate grammar, LSP client, and semantic highlighting. Packaged as tactus-0.1.1.vsix with Tactus logo icon. Publisher: AnthusAISolutions. Features include real-time validation, code completions, hover docs, and graceful degradation when LSP server unavailable.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
